info.title: demo-site HTTP API
info.description: Go/SQLite session API with shared HTTP/MCP business services for O01, O08 and O09, plus live and historical analysis. Other O/S domains remain browser-only.

get.description: Create or resume an isolated demo session; sets HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie. No raw token in JSON.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Browser-managed header; must match configured origins.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Browser-managed header; must match configured origins.

get.description: Cookie-authorized SSE for the current workspace. ready/heartbeat have no cursor; change contains WorkspaceEvent and an id. Last-Event-ID overrides after. Replays up to 128 events per poll; expired/foreign cursors produce sync.required. session.invalid closes the connection. No tokens in URLs.

200.description: UTF-8 event stream; change data is WorkspaceEvent JSON.

get.description: Read the site-wide active browser exposure setting. Default is disabled.

post.description: Change active exposure for all visitors with a valid demo session, current generation, trusted Origin and expected settings version. Independent from workspace resets and MCP.

Shared Go service. Actor IDs select fictional roles within the cookie-bound workspace. All writes check roles, generation, business version and idempotency; state, tasks, history and events commit in one SQLite transaction.
Read-only dynamic validation: runs the same rules in a transaction that is always rolled back, without publishing events or consuming an idempotency key.

200.description: Valid without committing any business state
